topic: Solomon Asch (1951) Swarthmore Line-Judgment Group Conformity Experiments & Berns et al. (2005) fMRI Perceptual-Amygdala Mechanism (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Solomon Asch's lone-ally variation crashing conformity from 37% down to 5%, paired with Gregory Berns's 2005 fMRI replication showing parietal spatial-map reshaping and amygdala alarm during group disagreement.
